Iran faces complete maritime oil export blockade for first time, with US facilitating 1.1 billion barrels through Strait of Hormuz.

Camp David emergency meeting on Iran; Financial Times reports Trump considering 'apocalyptic attack' option (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81910).

sections.threat_assessment: Iran faces unprecedented maritime blockade with zero oil exports, escalating US military buildup of 20,000 troops and air/naval assets, and Camp David deliberations on potential strikes. Hamas leadership decapitation attempt in Gaza signals continued Israeli operational tempo against senior commanders. Drone threats extend to Lebanon and Gulf infrastructure, including a Dubai satellite ground station previously hit. The FlyDubai 1073 attack attempt and ongoing West Bank closures indicate multi-front instability. Iran's internal security incidents in Sirjan and Mahabad suggest growing unrest amid external pressure.
sections.regional_response: Iraq diverting 2 million barrels crude via VLCC outside Hormuz to maintain revenue amid blockade. Saudi Arabia conducting airstrikes on Houthis in Sanaa. US facilitating 1.1 billion barrels through Hormuz while deploying significant military reinforcements. Qatar brothers and Tahnoon bin Zayed linked to US-Russia energy deal framework. West Bank sealed for Eid with 3 million Palestinians affected, enabling settlement expansion.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ali al-Alwamudi confirmed as Sinwar's successor and most senior Hamas figure in Gaza; his elimination would represent major leadership decapitation. US C-17 strategic transport over Palestine indicates logistical buildup. Jet activity over both western and eastern Tehran suggests sustained aerial operations or surveillance. Iraqi flights resuming from Najaf to Iran may indicate shifting airspace control dynamics. Dubai satellite ground station drone strike reveals Gulf infrastructure vulnerability.
